messages:
claire: Heads-up: Sentinel Health procurement asked for a short POC checklist: redacted ISO excerpt, SOC2 executive summary, signed pen-test attestation, and a 4h weekend vuln scan (they prefer Saturday night). They also want pricing for scan facilitation. cc @diego @olivia

diego: We can provide the docs. Pen-test attestation is our standard attestation but legal sometimes requests small wording changes. Security signs it.

olivia: Ops note: Saturday 22:00-02:00 UTC works but we need their firewall allowlist 24h ahead. If Redwood runs the scan we need ATO + SSO access for the engineer. If customer runs it, we provide staging creds and sample scan targets.

infra-bot: HOSTED_SCANNER_IPS: 13.52.101.9, 13.52.101.10. Bastion fingerprint available on request (sha256:ABCD...).

claire: Procurement also asked if running the scan is included in POC or billed separately. They want the attestation signed and returned within 48h if possible.

diego: Pricing guidance: artifact exchange (ISO/SOC2) included. Scan facilitation / live ops is billable. Recommend $1,000 as "POC scan facilitation & reporting (up to 4h)"; note customer responsible for firewall changes. I'll add this to the quote.

sec-bot: SECURITY: Pen-test attestation template path /compliance/templates/pen_test_attest_2026.docx. Manager-level approval required for signature. Any network access requires completed NDA and ATO. If legal redlines attestation, escalate to #sec-legal; turnaround may add 2-3 business days.

olivia: I'll prep the redacted ISO snippet and generate a 72h presign. Presign command I will use: aws s3 presign s3://evidence-bundles/sentinel/iso_redacted_v1.zip --expires-in 259200

claire: Customer proposed Saturday 22:00-02:00 UTC next weekend. Can we confirm and communicate the IPs?

infra-bot: Confirmed IPs above are valid. If they prefer bastion, request IP 13.52.101.11 and we'll provide SSH fingerprint. Need allowlist 24h prior.

acct-bot: QUOTE_UPDATE: Added line item "POC scan facilitation & reporting (up to 4h) - $1,000" to opportunity. Marked as billable and labeled for procurement.

olivia: Uploaded redacted ISO and posted presign (placeholder): https://redwood-evidence.s3.amazonaws.com/sentinel/iso_redacted_presign?token=XYZ

diego: Attached pen-test template to CRM and noted potential legal redline risk. I'll prepare the signed attestation pending security approval.

claire: Action list: 1) diego attach signed attestation (or escalate if redlines), 2) olivia share presign link and confirm ops window, 3) infra-bot confirm IPs in thread (done), 4) customer to provide firewall allowlist and NDA/ATO completion. I'll notify procurement once presign and quote are live.

olivia: Confirming presign posted. If they want Redwood to run the scan, we need allowlist for 13.52.101.9/10 (and 13.52.101.11 for bastion if requested) 24h prior and SSO invite.

claire: Thanks team 44d I'll follow up with Sentinel Health procurement and loop in legal if they edit the attestation.
